module.purpose: Provides a module-level cache for imported React DevTools timeline profiler files, returning TimelineData or Error via a thenable/Suspense pattern that survives React refreshes.
module.summary: This module maintains a static, module-scoped Map from file name to a thenable representing asynchronously imported timeline profiler data. The exported importFile function checks the cache, and if missing, creates a thenable hooked to a web worker import, storing callbacks for resolution or rejection. A helper readRecord reads the thenable via React.use when available, otherwise inspects status. The cache intentionally lives outside React state so it is not cleared on element refresh. The design supports Suspense and returns either processed data or an Error.
module.businessContext: Powers React DevTools timeline file import and profiling. If broken, users cannot load saved profiles or see cached data across UI refreshes.
